description_en: Deletes custom images in batches. After a custom image is deleted, simple application servers created from the image cannot use it to reset the system
description_zh: 如果您不再需要某些自定义镜像，可以将其批量删除。自定义镜像被删除后，使用该镜像创建的轻量应用服务器将无法使用该镜像重置系统
name: DeleteCustomImages

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to query available regions
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of the simple application servers. The value can be a JSON array that consists of multiple instance IDs. You can specify up to 15 IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的镜像ID。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持15个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: image_ids

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate the value from your client and ensure that it is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and can be up to 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
